name: @opentine/verify
description: Independent OpenTine verifier: canonical JSON, envelopes, every signature scheme (incl. ML-DSA-65), .tine v1-v5, packs, delegation chains and transparency-log proofs.

scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --test dist/test/conformance.test.js dist/test/cli.test.js dist/test/mldsa.test.js dist/test/zstd.test.js dist/test/trailers.test.js dist/test/claim.test.js dist/test/bundle.test.js dist/test/zstddict.test.js
